description: Submit a US A2P 10DLC campaign for a registered brand: smsBrandId (the 10DLC brand id sms_registration_status lists), useCase (e.g. MARKETING, MIXED, CUSTOMER_CARE, 2FA), description, messageFlow (how people opt in), samples (2 to 5 example texts), optInMessage / optOutMessage / helpMessage, hasLinks, hasPhone, privacyPolicyUrl, termsUrl; on Twilio also messagingServiceSid. Carriers review it; the provider bills the vetting and monthly fees to the account. Without confirm:true nothing is filed. Free in credits. Needs Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).

smsBrandId.description: the 10DLC brand id from sms_registration_status (named so it is never read as a Hermoso brand)

name: register_sms_campaign
title: Register a 10DLC campaign
